notes.title: RELEASE of Dark and Bright 1.1!
notes.content:
Hi! It's been some time since the release of Dark and Bright, a very meaningful and personal project to me that tells you a story about life, friendship, depression and the constant evaluation of life. 

[b]The game has grown a lot since release and now receives a big update to version 1.1! [/b]

Thanks to all the players who gave me feedback on the game over the last year. It's much much appreciated, and I really think the game developed quite well thanks to that. There are numerous quality-of-life improvements which were added to the game, and also some whole new features! Check them out here:

[h2]Dark and Bright 1.1[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29831450/8d9e94b0eb5d366752184de338dd786ee69e3cb2.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]The game will become much more enjoyable to everyone who just wants to play a story and not focus too much on RPG or puzzle gameplay, thanks to [b]a whole new difficulty mode[/b] introduced to the game: The "Story" difficulty setting.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29831450/e6af93e5b2af255337912a1ed9dbf62808893da4.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]A [b]new mission menu tab[/b] was added to the game. This is a real convenience feature for you: just look up where to go next if you want to proceed with the storyline. Of course you can still explore the world and play optional content besides the recommendation in this menu.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29831450/d7323e152d32c9bccea1106206841a2aa42bb7f6.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]The mission menu also shows you your [b]progress on sidequests[/b]. This way, you won't miss a bonus level anymore!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29831450/ddae7a425f4ab939fc83b5dd6cb1ee4475e05578.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]The game has undergone [b]major rebalancing[/b]. While the toughest mode remains the same, all other difficulty settings have been revised. However, if the game still feels too difficult, the new Story mode might just be the right thing for you!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29831450/64544378b12f693f50fcd529486479944999b7a6.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Collect [b]crowns[/b]! Be rewarded for a perfect level run more easily and gain an achievement for it - now allowing you to take damage at least once, recharge, miss a Quadrato and still gain a perfect run. Gameplay perfectionists may additionally like the crowns they'll wear in areas in which they have accomplished a perfect run.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29831450/0d2396374b200abd855a6de7b7e484f3bcacdb4d.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Minor story gaps have been addressed. A [b]new cutscene[/b] and a few changes to some dialogs add more continuity to the storyline.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29831450/3a1675799d8d408387b96aa930182a035d43ce59.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Uncover [b]new paintings in the musum[/b], adding small bits of information to the story.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29831450/f2aba12f2220dc955593086dc7b537433c7dbe39.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Bonus levels and mines are affected by the chosen difficulty now[/b], making it easier to finish them. Additional NPCs here and there may lend you some help.
[/list]

[b]As these were the biggest changes to the game, there are also plenty of smaller ones:[/b]
[list]
[*]No more charge at ViviBanks!
[*]Heal spots will only be activated if you lost lifepoints or energy (that one is quite essential when aiming at perfect level runs)
[*]"Start level" and "Explore Area" switched positions. No more misclicks!
[*]Common monsters do not instantly attack
[*]Slight adjustments to upgrade costs
[*]Some dialogs and cutscenes were shortened to avoid repetitions
[*]Certain passages of the game have been changed to make them more player-friendly
[*]Certain lines have been added to a certain cutscene to give more answers to the story
[*]Major and minor bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: Dark and Bright 1.1 is coming soon!
notes.content:
Hi! It's been some time since the release of Dark and Bright, a very meaningful and personal project to me that tells you a story about life, friendship, depression and the constant evaluation of life. 

[b]If you considered playing this game at some point but haven't yet, this update is for you![/b]

I'm happy that I have received useful feedback from players during 2020 and 2021. I'm very grateful for the opportunity to see people still playing the game from time to time, being excited for its story and telling me about their thoughts and theories on it. When receiving honest and enthusiastic feedback like that, I really feel like the realization of this rather unusual-looking game was really worth it, and what I wanted to convey with the very abstract game concept was indeed conveyed to some.

Having been motivated to upgrade this game to something even more enjoyable with the help of your feedback, I couldn't help but address some minor and major flaws of the game, which was not always easy after all the years, so it [b]really[/b] took me longer than expected. Eventually, I was able to get rid of all those tiny little flaws and also the big bites as well, so right now I'm very happy to announce that [b]Dark and Bright will be updated to v1.1 in the next few weeks[/b] and really become the game I wanted it to be. 

[h2]Dark and Bright 1.1[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29831450/8d9e94b0eb5d366752184de338dd786ee69e3cb2.jpg[/img]

Most importantly, the game will become much more enjoyable to everyone who just wants to play a story and not focus too much on RPG or puzzle gameplay, thanks to [b]a whole new difficulty mode[/b] introduced to the game. 

There's much more - some new additions to the game, but mostly the many, many little quality-of-life improvements that should really improve your game experience in total. I will introduce them to you when 1.1 is released - soon!

Thank you, and see you around!
